mentions.name: tmux-agent-switcher
mentions.description: A tmux plugin that helps manage work with many AI agents inside tmux. Pressing ctrl+n opens a sidebar listing all current tmux tabs/windows along with the agents' statuses, and offers several navigation modes: vim-style j/k bindings with numeric quick jumps, session-number-then-tab-number navigation, and search for users with many sessions open. Built to keep an existing tmux workflow instead of switching to other agent-management tools.
mentions.problem: Keeping track of and switching between many agent sessions in tmux is hard, and existing tools in this space require giving up one's core tmux setup.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A tmux plugin that makes is better to work with many agents:

https://github.com/Ymirke/tmux-agent-switcher

You press ctrl+n and you get a sidebar showing all the tmux tabs you currently have and the statuses of the agents.
mentions.author: ymir_e
